result.topic_en: This is an engraved plate (Tab. VI) of four geometric figures showing tubes or channels through which fluid flows: a curved tube segment, a circular-arc channel, a straight inclined channel, and a channel of several straight segments, with labelled points used in Euler's analysis of fluid friction.
